changes: First release for Digitakt II OS 1.17: Morpha, a wavetable synth in the track's machine list.
POS morphs through a table of waves: a wavetable file, any sample (scanned smoothly), or a built-in table of 48 waves.
WARP bends the wave four ways (BEND, SYNC, MIRR, FOLD) by AMT; DETN adds detuned unison and MIX blends in a sine an octave down.
Every knob glides smoothly, and the sub sine never drops below C1.
Chords through the base's linked voices (SETTINGS > VOICES).
